description: Υπουργικές Αποφάσεις & Νομοθετικές πράξεις σιδηροδρομικών υπηρεσιών is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δ/νση Συνδυασμένων Μεταφορών (Τμήμα Σιδηροδρομικών και Συνδυασμένων Μεταφορών). Ministarske odluke i uključivanje zakonodavstva EU-a o regulaciji željezničkog tržišta. Coverage: Δ/νση Συνδυασμένων Μεταφορών (Τμήμα Σιδηροδρομικών και Συνδυασμένων Μεταφορών). The portal shows the English title as "Ministerbeslut och lagstiftningsakter om järnvägstjänster" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Δ/νση Συνδυασμένων Μεταφορών (Τμήμα Σιδηροδρομικών και Συνδυασμένων Μεταφορών). Its keywords include Μεταφορές, repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2026-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
